object: choline chloride deep eutectic solvent constituent
problem: What are the true fusion enthalpy and melting point of choline chloride, which decomposes before melting?
mechanism_or_method: Fast scanning calorimetry with micro-XRD and high-speed microscopy outruns decomposition, revealing choline chloride as an ionic plastic crystal.
limitation: Limited to ammonium-salt plastic crystals; generality to other DES components is hypothesised, not tested.

object: magnetic colloidal collectives driven by magnetic and optical fields
problem: How can synthetic colloidal collectives perform stable 3D locomotion underwater without dispersion?
mechanism_or_method: Bimodal actuation: magnetic field assembles colloids, light-driven photothermal convective flow propels the collective in 3D.
limitation: Demonstrated only in lab-scale water cells with limited control precision and payload.

object: ultrathin sub-micro porous polymer membranes for H2/CO2 separation
problem: Can polymer membranes deliver high H2 permeance and H2/CO2 selectivity under industrial conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Controlled conversion of amine-linked polymer films to benzimidazole-and-amine-linked layers creates molecular-sieving sub-micro pores in 13-30 nm films.
limitation: Lab-scale films; long-term stability and scale-up under real gas streams not shown.

object: photoreactive organic molecular crystal actuators
problem: How efficiently can organic crystals convert light into mechanical work across polymorphs?
mechanism_or_method: Photodimerization in three polymorphs yields bending, rolling or flexible responses, with work densities measured for acicular and prismatic crystals.
limitation: Single compound with small crystals; work density varies widely and cyclic durability is unclear.

object: hierarchical origami metastructures
problem: How can one structure transform into many volumetric shapes with few actuation degrees of freedom?
mechanism_or_method: Polyhedron-based hierarchical thick-origami construction with simple transition kinematics, supported by theoretical models and robotic demonstrations.
limitation: Demonstrated only up to meter scale prototypes; actuation and control robustness in real environments unproven.
decision_relevance: Informs design of reconfigurable deployable structures and transformer robots.

object: polyarylate thin-film composite membranes
problem: Can phenolphthalein-based polyarylate membranes give high organic solvent permeance with sharp molecular cutoff?
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial polymerization with 3D phenolphthalein monomer tunes microporosity and interconnectivity, supported by molecular dynamics simulations.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term fouling and scale-up in real pharmaceutical streams unreported.

object: critical mineral project investment risk
problem: How does back-ended risk raise the cost of capital for critical minerals and can AI reduce it?
mechanism_or_method: Economic theory introducing a back-ended risk premium, linking project duration and required return to AI-driven shortening of mining projects.
limitation: Theoretical argument with limited empirical validation of AI's effect on project duration or risk.

object: millimeter-scale soft-rigid hybrid continuum robots
problem: How can small soft robots integrate actuators, controllers and sensors without manual assembly?
mechanism_or_method: Monolithic fabrication of PTFE film ionic-fluid actuators with a rigid-flexible mechanical controller and ionic resistive self-sensing.
limitation: Tethered fluid actuation; demonstrated on benchtop tasks, not in clinical or in vivo conditions.
decision_relevance: Guides fabrication choices for self-sensing millimeter-scale surgical or manipulation robots.

object: Al2O3-GdAlO3 eutectic ceramic micropillars
problem: Can refined eutectic microstructure give plastic deformability to brittle high-strength ceramics at room temperature?
mechanism_or_method: Submicron fibrous eutectic microstructure activates prismatic and basal slip in Al2O3, shown by micropillar compression.
limitation: Only micropillar-scale plasticity shown; bulk behavior and size effects remain unverified.
decision_relevance: Suggests microstructure refinement route to tougher structural ceramics.

object: hydrogel-salt composite moisture-capture materials
problem: What variables control moisture uptake, sorption enthalpy and kinetics of hydrogel-salt composites?
mechanism_or_method: Thermodynamic and mass-transport models validated against synthesized composites show the salt, not the polymer, dominates performance.
limitation: Validated on a limited set of synthesized composites under controlled humidity, not real devices.
decision_relevance: Guides salt selection and system-level design of atmospheric water harvesting.

object: self-adaptive photochromic materials with DASA switches
problem: Can materials intrinsically adopt the color of their background without electronics for active camouflage?
mechanism_or_method: Negative photochromic DASAs with fixed dyes create an absorption gap at incident wavelengths, switching color spontaneously.
limitation: Lab films; color range, response time and fatigue under outdoor conditions not established.

object: transparent ultrasonic transducers from relaxor ferroelectric crystals
problem: Can a transparent transducer achieve high sensitivity and bandwidth for fast photoacoustic microvascular imaging?
mechanism_or_method: PIN-PMN-PT transparent crystals with ITO electrodes and quartz-epoxy matching layers give 28.5 MHz, 78% bandwidth and 13 dB SNR gain.
limitation: Demonstrated in mouse cortex only; crystal cost and field-of-view scaling remain open.
decision_relevance: Favors relaxor crystals over LiNbO3 for transparent photoacoustic probes.

object: peptide-based inflammation-responsive titanium implant coating
problem: Can a sequentially releasing coating follow bone regeneration stages to improve implant osseointegration?
mechanism_or_method: Mussel-inspired DOPA-P1@P2 layered peptide coating via click chemistry sequentially modulates macrophage polarization, angiogenesis and osteogenesis.
limitation: Animal model results only; clinical translation and long-term stability of the coating untested.

object: acid mine drainage treatment with electrochemically activated limestone
problem: Can limestone electrochemistry recover valuable metals from acid mine drainage at lower cost and emissions than lime dosing?
mechanism_or_method: Electro-reduction plus local high-pH precipitation on an electrochemically activated limestone system extracts Cu, Cd and Zn at high purity.
limitation: Bench-scale reactor with limited actual AMD samples; cost estimates are model-based.
decision_relevance: Supports electrochemical limestone over lime dosing for AMD remediation.

object: compaction-resistant crosslinked polyimide-supported reverse osmosis membranes
problem: Can RO membranes resist physical compaction at ultrahigh pressure up to 200 bar?
mechanism_or_method: Crosslinked phase-inverted polyimide support with interfacial polyamide layer forms a fully thermoset composite membrane.
limitation: Lab-scale coupons; long-term fouling and module-scale performance not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Enables ultrahigh-pressure RO design for hypersaline brine concentration.

object: squarate-pillared titanium oxide quantum sieve
problem: Can a practical porous material separate deuterium from hydrogen with high selectivity, stability and scalable synthesis?
mechanism_or_method: Ultra-microporous squarate-pillared titanium oxide hybrid framework performs kinetic quantum sieving with regenerable adsorption.
limitation: Lab-scale assessment; operation at cryogenic conditions and industrial scale not demonstrated.

object: FeZr2 uniaxial negative thermal expansion alloy
problem: Why does FeZr2 show giant uniaxial negative thermal expansion over a very wide temperature range?
mechanism_or_method: Diffraction experiments and DFT show NTE arises from phonon coupling in a flexible framework with soft bonds, driven by optical branches.
limitation: Single alloy and uniaxial effect; polycrystal compensation performance and practical use not shown.

object: crystalline/amorphous nanolaminated alloy composite
problem: Can elemental partitioning drive crystalline-to-amorphous transformation during quasi-static plastic deformation?
mechanism_or_method: Atomic intermixing at interfaces with large negative mixing enthalpy amorphizes the crystalline layers, shortening dislocation mean free path.
limitation: Thin-film nanolaminate in one alloy system; bulk scalability and generality unproven.
decision_relevance: Guides enthalpy-based design of crystal-glass composite alloys.

object: LaFe-based dual-phase zero thermal expansion alloy
problem: Can an alloy combine near-isotropic zero thermal expansion with very high toughness?
mechanism_or_method: Chemical partition in a natural dual-phase LaFe54Co3.5Si3.35 structure tunes magnetic expansion while interface bonding boosts toughness.
limitation: ZTE only over a narrow 260-310 K window in a single composition.

object: global aerosol aqueous sulfate formation pathways
problem: How much does H2O2 oxidation in aerosol water contribute to global sulfate formation despite SO2 reductions?
mechanism_or_method: GEOS-Chem chemical transport simulations combined with theoretical calculations quantify aerosol aqueous pathways and their two-decade shifts.
limitation: Model-based pathways with uncertain aerosol-water kinetics; limited observational validation stated.

object: order-disorder core-shell nanostructured alloy
problem: Can a core-shell nanostructure give nanocrystalline alloys both high strength and ductility with thermal stability?
mechanism_or_method: Ordered superlattice cores retain dislocations while a 3 nm disordered fcc shell emits dislocations and accommodates grain boundary strain.
limitation: Small-scale tensile specimens; fatigue, scalability and processing cost not addressed.
decision_relevance: Guides alloy design for strong yet ductile nanostructured components.

object: formate metal-organic frameworks for fluorinated gas separation
problem: Can MOFs separate C3F6 from C3F8 to produce high-purity electronic specialty gas?
mechanism_or_method: Biomimetic multi-hydrogen confined cavities in cobalt formate recognize C3F6 and size-exclude C3F8, supported by DFT and in situ spectroscopy.
limitation: Breakthrough tests at lab scale; industrial gas stream impurities and cycling not shown.

object: diselenide dynamic covalent bonded cholesteric liquid crystal elastomers
problem: Can CLCEs retain tuned optical properties so colored patterns can be programmed and reprogrammed?
mechanism_or_method: Diselenide dynamic covalent bonds exchange under visible light and strain, locking structural color into the elastomer film.
limitation: Lab films; patterning durability, resolution limits and cycling fatigue only partly characterized.

object: direct air capture routes for climate-neutral aviation
problem: When do synthetic fuels from DACCU beat an emit-and-remove DACCS strategy for climate-neutral aviation?
mechanism_or_method: Time-dynamic techno-economic assessment comparing DACCU fuels and DACCS under 2050 CO2 and contrail-inclusive climate neutrality targets.
limitation: Conclusions depend on assumed electricity, kerosene prices and contrail mitigation efficacy.
decision_relevance: Informs whether to invest in synthetic aviation fuels versus carbon removal.

object: laser powder bed fusion chemically complex intermetallic alloy
problem: Can brittle ordered intermetallic alloys be additively manufactured crack-free with high strength and ductility?
mechanism_or_method: LPBF of chemically complex intermetallic alloy yields ordered superlattice grains with disordered interfacial nanolayers and multiple dislocation substructures.
limitation: Single alloy composition; fatigue and complex-geometry component performance not evaluated.
decision_relevance: Supports printing intermetallic components with complex geometries.

object: bistable fabric mechanisms for soft pneumatic robots
problem: Can a single soft module fuse actuation and valve control for electronics-free autonomous robots?
mechanism_or_method: Two bonded fabric chambers with embedded tubes buckle bistably, switching tube kinking to act as actuator, valve and logic element.
limitation: Needs external constant-pressure air supply; demonstrated on benchtop grippers and crawlers only.
decision_relevance: Guides use of bistable fabric valves in untethered pneumatic robot design.

object: biodegradable origami soft robotic system
problem: Can a soft robot be built from biodegradable materials in a closed ecological loop?
mechanism_or_method: Plasticized cellulose film origami with NaCl-infused ionic gelatin organogel sensors enables self-sensing teleoperated robot that biodegrades.
limitation: Lab demonstration with limited durability and actuation force compared with conventional robots.

object: solid-liquid contact electrification device for H2O2 and energy
problem: Can solid-liquid interfacial charge transfer simultaneously generate H2O2 and harvest electricity from flowing water?
mechanism_or_method: Electron transfer at the solid-liquid interface forms hydroxyl radicals yielding H2O2, while an external electrode harvests power from flow.
limitation: Lab-scale flow device; H2O2 yield and durability under practical conditions not detailed.

object: cationic triazolyl polyamide nanofiltration membranes
problem: Can molecular engineering of polyamide overcome the permeance-selectivity tradeoff for cation separation?
mechanism_or_method: Cationic triazolyl heterocyclic polyamide formed by interfacial polymerization regulates subnanometer pores and ion/water affinity, supported by molecular simulations.
limitation: Lab-scale testing with model salt solutions; long-term fouling and real brine performance unreported.

object: metasurface-enhanced radiative cooling cement
problem: Can a scalable structural cement achieve durable passive daytime radiative cooling?
mechanism_or_method: Pressure-driven fabrication self-assembles reflective ettringite with hierarchical pores, giving 96.2% solar reflectance and 96.0% emissivity.
limitation: Short outdoor tests; life-cycle carbon claim relies on machine-learning-guided assessment assumptions.
decision_relevance: Supports radiative-cooling cement as a building envelope material choice.

object: heat transfer in fractured geothermal rock
problem: How does the heat transfer coefficient in fracture networks depend on flow velocity?
mechanism_or_method: Laboratory single-fracture experiments and numerical modeling show heterogeneous, velocity-dependent coefficients that single-fracture data can approximate.
limitation: Lab-scale fractures; field-scale reservoir validation not provided.
decision_relevance: Improves temperature prediction and reservoir design in geothermal systems.

object: MDCK epithelial monolayers
problem: How do cell adhesion, density and substrate stiffness affect hexatic-to-nematic order crossover in epithelia?
mechanism_or_method: Orientational order analysis of MDCK monolayers with varied density, E-cadherin presence and substrate stiffness.
limitation: Single cell line in vitro; relevance to in vivo tissue development is inferred.

object: printed luminescent flying seed sensors
problem: Can eco-friendly artificial seeds disperse by wind and report temperature optically from a distance?
mechanism_or_method: 3D-printed PLA seed-like fliers mimicking Acer aerodynamics embed lanthanide-doped particles with temperature-dependent photoluminescence read via near-infrared.
limitation: Lab-scale flight and sensing tests; field deployment, readout range and degradation not shown.

object: thioindigo photoswitch-containing polymers and hydrogels
problem: Can thioindigo be incorporated into polymers and hydrogels to switch material properties with visible light?
mechanism_or_method: Thioindigo bismethacrylate linker enables thiol-ene step-growth polymerization; a photochemical action plot identifies optimal switching wavelengths.
limitation: Stiffness modulation magnitude and cycling stability in cellular settings are only modestly characterized.

object: regional resource-based industrial symbiosis system
problem: How can industrial structure be optimized to cut carbon and waste in a resource-based region?
mechanism_or_method: Integrated optimization modelling framework with scenario analysis, applied to the Qinghai Lake region.
limitation: Single regional case study; results depend on assumed technology and economic parameters.
decision_relevance: Guides regional industrial structure and symbiosis planning for low-carbon transition.

object: printed ionic hydrogel power sources inspired by electric eels
problem: Can consecutive multimaterial printing produce stretchable, high-voltage ionic hydrogel power sources efficiently?
mechanism_or_method: Multichannel printhead consecutively prints salinity-gradient hydrogel units with seamless interfaces, assembled in series and parallel.
limitation: Low power output and finite lifetime from ion gradient depletion; only wristwatch-level demonstration.

object: soft-magnetic high entropy alloy fibers
problem: How can soft-magnetic fibers combine low coercivity with high strength and plasticity?
mechanism_or_method: One-step in-rotating-water spinning produces coarse-grained FeCoNiAlTaSi HEA fibers with coherent nanoprecipitates reducing domain wall pinning.
limitation: Single composition with micron-diameter fibers; fatigue and bulk scale-up not examined.

object: vacancy formation and migration in high-entropy alloys
problem: What determines site-specific vacancy formation energy and migration barriers in chemically disordered HEAs?
mechanism_or_method: Electronic descriptor combining electronegativity and valence-electron number, from a tight-binding model, yields analytical models of formation and migration energies.
limitation: Validated against computed energies for selected alloys; experimental vacancy measurements not included in abstract.
decision_relevance: Speeds screening of HEAs for radiation resistance and mechanical performance.

object: topological single-atom Mn1/CeO2 catalyst for NOx removal
problem: Can asymmetric single-atom site design deliver site-specific selectivity and activity for NOx removal?
mechanism_or_method: DFT/AIMD-guided topological single-atom design with electronic shielding, synthesized by charge-transfer approach and checked by in situ spectroscopy and LCA.
limitation: Lab catalytic testing; durability against poisons in real flue gas not shown.

object: shape-morphing flexible neuromorphic actuator devices
problem: Can one flexible device integrate synaptic computation and muscle-like actuation for perception-action coupling?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrophilic nanochannels with silver nanowires store hydrated cations, enabling synaptic function and deformation-based actuation.
limitation: Lab demonstrations with humidity-dependent ionic behavior; stability and scalability not established.

object: high-entropy Zintl thermoelectric materials
problem: How do atomic-to-nanoscale chemical fluctuations enhance thermoelectric performance in high-entropy materials?
mechanism_or_method: Synthesis of ultrahigh-entropy AB2Sb2-type Zintls where chemical fluctuations and unusual occupations suppress lattice thermal conductivity, reaching zT 1.2.
limitation: Peak zT at 750 K only; device-level efficiency and long-term stability not reported.

object: 4D morphing thermo-responsive hydrogel for encryption
problem: Can programmable hydrogel shape morphing gate optical information for secure encryption?
mechanism_or_method: Oriented polymer chains in thermo-responsive networks couple chain elastic stress and deswelling stress for programmable bending or flattening gating optical patterns.
limitation: Slow thermal response and lab-scale demonstrations; security level against decryption is not quantified.

object: carbon molecular sieve hollow fiber membranes for H2/CO2
problem: Can membranes achieve very high H2/CO2 selectivity at high temperature for one-step fuel-grade H2 production?
mechanism_or_method: Carbon molecular sieve hollow fibers with refined ultramicropores give H2/CO2 selectivity above 7000 at 150 C, with process modeling.
limitation: Lab-scale fibers; stability with real syngas contaminants and module scale-up untested.
decision_relevance: Suggests one-step membrane H2 enrichment could replace pressure swing adsorption.

object: triboelectric self-powered environmental sensing system
problem: How can irregular rain-driven TENG output be used to power and calibrate temperature and humidity sensing?
mechanism_or_method: A calibration resistor in parallel with the sensor network monitors TENG output in real time to correct sensing signals.
limitation: Tested under waterfalls and rainfall only; long-term outdoor durability and other sensed variables not shown.

object: photopyroelectric slippery surface for bubble manipulation
problem: How can light steer, split and detach underwater bubbles robustly and contactlessly?
mechanism_or_method: NIR irradiation of a sandwich photopyroelectric slippery surface generates dielectric wetting and nonuniform fields giving Laplace and dielectrophoresis forces.
limitation: Small-scale lab demonstrations; scalability and long-term surface stability not established.

object: ZnNC catalyst for selective hydrodeoxygenation
problem: How can alpha,beta-unsaturated carbonyls be selectively hydrodeoxygenated to alkenes?
mechanism_or_method: ZnNC-900 catalyst with Lewis acid-base sites hydrogenates C=O while Zn-Nx sites drive subsequent hydrodeoxygenation.
limitation: Laboratory batch catalysis; catalyst lifetime and scale-up not discussed.

object: planar acoustic metalens
problem: How can a metalens capture and focus sound over a wide angle without coma and field-curvature aberrations?
mechanism_or_method: Planar-thin aberration-free metalens using perfect acoustic symmetry conversion gives about 140 degree field-of-hearing with short focal length.
limitation: Demonstrated for airborne sound in a narrow band; broadband and 3D performance unreported.
decision_relevance: Enables compact wide-angle acoustic sensing and source tracking designs.

object: local chemical fluctuation in high-entropy thermoelectrics
problem: Which element characteristics drive local chemical fluctuation and thereby lattice thermal conductivity in high-entropy thermoelectrics?
mechanism_or_method: Atomic-resolution chemical mapping quantifies electronegativity, mass and radius contributions, with elements chosen to enlarge lattice distortion and strain fluctuation.
limitation: Limited to a few material systems; thermoelectric figure of merit is not the focus.

object: covalent organic framework membrane reactor
problem: Can COF membrane reactors greatly accelerate catalytic reactions compared with homogeneous catalysts and powders?
mechanism_or_method: Flow through a COF membrane concentrates reactants and rapidly removes water, lowering apparent activation energy for Knoevenagel condensation.
limitation: Demonstrated on a model Knoevenagel reaction; broader reaction scope and membrane lifetime unclear.

object: passive isothermal film with radiative cooling and water sorption
problem: Can a passive film hold temperature near 25 C all day in arid climates without energy use?
mechanism_or_method: Radiative cooling PDMS grating unit combined with water desorption and ammonium nitrate dissolution thermal storage, reversed at night.
limitation: Millimeter-scale film tested in limited conditions; consumable salt cycling and long-term durability uncertain.
decision_relevance: Informs passive thermal regulation design for buildings in arid climates.

object: soft gripper with bioinspired slip sensor
problem: How can soft grippers sense incipient slip in real time to enable closed-loop grasping?
mechanism_or_method: Three-dimensional crack and stress-concentration slip sensor integrated on a gripper with linear pressure-to-force response forms a closed sensorimotor loop.
limitation: Benchtop grasping tests; sensor durability and performance on varied objects not fully quantified.
decision_relevance: Guides sensor integration for slip-aware soft grasping.

object: non-contact ultrasound in laser additive manufacturing melt pool
problem: Is acoustic cavitation really needed for ultrasound-induced grain refinement during laser melting?
mechanism_or_method: Low-intensity non-contact ultrasound below cavitation threshold drives acoustic streaming with Marangoni flow, fragmenting dendrites into fine equiaxed grains.
limitation: Shown for specific alloy and setup; generality to other materials and large industrial builds unproven.
decision_relevance: Allows contactless low-intensity ultrasound in large-scale additive manufacturing.

object: graphene-AFM tip friction under external electric fields
problem: How does an external electric field tune friction at a graphene interface with different tips?
mechanism_or_method: Atomic force microscope friction measurements on single layer graphene under gate field, interpreted via stick-slip, electron-phonon coupling and viscous electronic flow.
limitation: Origin of enhanced friction with semiconducting tips is discussed but not conclusively resolved.

object: Nafion polyelectrolyte membrane for electro-ionic soft actuators
problem: How can ionic conducting network structure be improved to speed up and strengthen electro-ionic artificial muscles?
mechanism_or_method: Functionally antagonistic solvent assembles Nafion micelles whose ionic surfaces fuse into a continuous conducting phase during casting.
limitation: Low bandwidth below 10 Hz and low blocking force relative to rigid actuators.

object: nanotextured metal powders for laser powder bed fusion
problem: Can surface nanogrooves on metal powders raise laser absorptivity for printing reflective metals efficiently?
mechanism_or_method: Generalizable process adds nanoscale grooves to powders; plasmon-enabled light concentration and multiple scattering raise absorptivity up to 70%.
limitation: Copper printed only to 92% relative density; powder flowability and mechanical properties of parts not detailed.
decision_relevance: Lowers laser energy needed to print copper and tungsten powders.

object: localized molten gallium stamps for transfer printing
problem: How can ultrathin membranes and 3D objects be transferred without damage from stamp contact force?
mechanism_or_method: Laser or hotplate locally melts solid gallium for gentle conformal contact, then solidification gives reversible adhesion and interlocking grip.
limitation: Demonstrated at lab scale; throughput, gallium residue and alignment precision are not reported.

object: stretchable tactile glove with visual-tactile learning
problem: How can hand-object states be captured during forceful manipulation of deformable objects?
mechanism_or_method: A 1152-channel stretchable tactile glove with strain-suppression calibration and a visual-tactile joint deep learning framework reconstructs states.
limitation: Tested on 24 objects in 6 categories; reconstruction error of 1.8 cm limits fine manipulation.
decision_relevance: Informs tactile sensing choices for teleoperation and robot manipulation learning.

object: bottlebrush polymer elastomer networks
problem: Can stiffness and extensibility of single-network elastomers be decoupled, contrary to the stiffer-less-stretchable dogma?
mechanism_or_method: Foldable bottlebrush network strands unfold to release stored length while side chains set modulus, giving 40-fold higher breaking strain.
limitation: Demonstrated at low modulus (30 kPa); applicability to stiff engineering elastomers not shown.

object: shallow landslide susceptibility mapping
problem: Can landslide susceptibility be modeled without landslide inventories, using only topography?
mechanism_or_method: Probabilistic morphometric analysis of elevation data assumes hillslopes with higher relief and gradient than surroundings are more landslide-prone.
limitation: Tested in the northwestern United States; ignores rainfall, soil and geology triggers.
decision_relevance: Enables hazard mapping where no landslide inventory exists.

object: prestressed tensegrity hydrogels
problem: Can hydrogels be engineered with tensegrity architecture to be stiff, tough and bimodulus?
mechanism_or_method: In-situ enzyme-induced amino acid crystal growth within preformed polymer networks interlocks microcrystal sticks in a prestressed matrix.
limitation: Lab characterization only; long-term stability and biological performance in tissue applications untested.
